What's new in ShawNotch 1.7.8

  • Pausing no longer makes the time jump back and forth. Spotify reports where a song was when it started playing before it reports where you paused it, and ShawNotch now waits for the real position.
  • The time at the end of the playback line now shows the song's whole length to begin with. Click it to see the time left instead.
